en: A vintage black-and-white panoramic view of a small alpine town nestled in a valley beneath dramatic jagged mountain peaks. The settlement consists of several multi‑story hotels and houses, a church with a steeple, and other buildings surrounded by forests and open meadows. At the top right of the image is printed the caption in Italian indicating the panorama of San Martino di Castrozza at an elevation of 1444 meters above sea level.
